title: e2e_intelligent_director_v2
notes: Director decides take length, clip_speed (incl slow-mo), multi-cam, stage vs spoken, catalog vs t2m when needed.

shots.text: Walk forward while saying welcome to our one minute avatar pipeline showcase. Today we prove face, body, and camera can run as one production system.
shots.spoken: Welcome to our one minute avatar pipeline showcase. Today we prove face, body, and camera can run as one production system.
shots.summary: WS follow walk — catalog walk loop

shots.text: Wave and say hello everyone, great to see you all here today. Thanks for joining this end to end test of our movie level avatar stack.
shots.spoken: Hello everyone, great to see you all here today. Thanks for joining this end to end test of our movie level avatar stack.
shots.summary: MS wave — catalog one-shot then hold

shots.text: Let me carefully explain how the face engine, body motion router, and cinematic camera planner work together in perfect sync on a shared master timeline.
shots.spoken: Let me carefully explain how the face engine, body motion router, and cinematic camera planner work together in perfect sync on a shared master timeline.

shots.text: That was completely unacceptable when the motion and lips fell out of sync before. We refuse to ship broken continuity ever again.
shots.spoken: That was completely unacceptable when the motion and lips fell out of sync before. We refuse to ship broken continuity ever again.

shots.text: I feel terrible about those early failed demos, but we learned a lot from them and rebuilt the bake then play pipeline from the ground up.
shots.spoken: I feel terrible about those early failed demos, but we learned a lot from them and rebuilt the bake then play pipeline from the ground up.

shots.text: Oh wow, I had no idea the full movie package could plan multi shot continuity, world state, and camera coverage like this in one pass.
shots.spoken: Oh wow, I had no idea the full movie package could plan multi shot continuity, world state, and camera coverage like this in one pass.

shots.text: Walk forward then turn slightly and raise both arms while saying now open vocabulary motion fills the gaps the catalog cannot cover.
shots.stage: Walk forward then turn slightly and raise both arms
shots.spoken: Now open vocabulary motion fills the gaps the catalog cannot cover.
shots.humanml_prompt: a person walks forward then turns slightly and raises both arms looking happy
shots.summary: Multi-step stage → t2m MoMask when needed

shots.text: Celebrate and say I happily won the game, the pipeline works end to end, yeh! Thank you for watching this one minute end to end test of our production movie pipeline.
shots.spoken: I happily won the game, the pipeline works end to end, yeh! Thank you for watching this one minute end to end test of our production movie pipeline.
shots.summary: MS crane up victory — slightly slow celebrate
